mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE is below 4.5%, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for UNRATE < 4.5% is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) above 730,000 million dollars and housing starts (HOUST) above 1,450 thousand units indicates strong aggregate demand, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 730000 and HOUST > 1450, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing expansion (INDPRO > 102.0), supply chain bottlenecks ease, leading to higher corporate margins and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 102.0, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for INDPRO > 102.0 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS) above its 5-year average indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 5-year average, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,400 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1400, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for HOUST < 1400 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 3.5% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 325 indicate an active monetary tightening cycle, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 3.5 and CPIAUCSL > 325, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO < 100.0), supply chain disruptions increase, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100.0, SPX 5-day returns are negative in less than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC for INDPRO < 100.0 is below 0.03.
